coordinate_convention: origin=(0,0) top-left; x right; y down; normalized coordinates divide by (width-1,height-1)

adjacency_method.note: nested facility footprints are retained as interaction/entry neighbors

interpretation.bidirectional: 普通地面机器人在两个区域之间可双向通行
interpretation.bidirectional_conditional: 连接高地/坡，需按机器人底盘、离地间隙和现场安全裕度检查
interpretation.bidirectional_facility_access: 所属方机器人可进出设施区域进行部署、防守或规则交互；不表示设施可作为普通穿行走廊
interpretation.blocked: 不作为普通穿行边；设施只保留交互/占用语义，场外和未知默认禁止
interpretation.role_policy: 工程和哨兵的己方侧限制是战术先验，不是物理单向墙；单位方向写入 unit_directions
